entities.summary: Andrea Collarini is an American-born Argentine professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 177 achieved on 24 April 2023 and a doubles ranking of No. 193 reached on 1 August 2022. He plays mostly on the ATP Challenger Tour, where he has won four titles in singles and three in doubles.
